newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morroco's opposition backs jobless hunger-strikers.
newsitem.headline: Morroco's opposition backs jobless hunger-strikers.

text.p: Morocco's main opposition parties and workers' unions on Tuesday urged the government to open talks with 40 jobless university graduates staging a hunger strike over lack of job opportunities.
"We call on the authorities to open a responsible and serious dialogue with the jobless graduates," said 11 parties and unions in a statement.
Unemployed university graduates are staging sporadic hunger strikes in Rabat, Sale and other cities since last May to pressure the government to help them find work.
King Hassan last week ordered Interior Minister Driss Basri to recruit 70 graduates after a series of hunger strikes in Rabat.
Urban unemployment is estimated at 18.5 percent.
